name: Atlantic North Equatorial Undercurrent
scope: Declared western-to-central Atlantic subsurface reference reach between observations at 35 W near 5 N and the central observational neighborhood at 23 W near 5 N. Connecting vertices are editorial, not an observed continuous axis. Excludes NBC/NEC source recirculation, surface NECC flow, uncertain filaments east of 28 W and farther-east termination. Not full-current source-to-end length.
layer: Subsurface eastward NEUC context. The central mooring study defines 65–270 m; historical western cores lie near sigma-theta 26.75 kg/m3. These different vertical definitions are not imposed as one uniform layer along the reference line.
time_convention: Western sections in February 1993 and April 1996; central moorings June 2006–February 2008 and November 2009–January 2018 with 2002–2018 ship sections. Editorial section-to-section geography, not simultaneous observations or an annual/seasonal axis.
source_locator: Bourles et al. (1999), section 4.8, p. 21163: 35 W NEUC centered at 5 N in February 1993 and April 1996; core near sigma-theta 26.75. Sections 4.6 and 6.1 separate source retroflection from the named current; eastern filament context cites earlier work.
source_citation: Bourles, Gouriou and Chuchla (1999), On the circulation in the upper layer of the western equatorial Atlantic, JGR Oceans 104(C9), 21151–21170, doi:10.1029/1999JC900058.
source_license: Source PDF states copyright 1999 American Geophysical Union; repository access does not establish an open reuse license. Facts paraphrased with attribution; no source figure or observed field copied.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects rounded 5 N vertices between separate 35 W and 23 W observational neighborhoods. Northern/southern smooth bends and alternate central gates are sensitivity choices, not source-diagnosed axes. No continuous physical connection, uniform depth, filament path, transport-loop length or seasonal position is established by this sketch.

alternative_routes.interpretation: OSW northern bend and later observational-neighborhood truncation, not a seasonal axis or lateral edge.
OSW southern bend and earlier central truncation, not a source filament or current width.

scenario_rule: Three declared reach shapes crossed with uniform longitude shifts -0.25/0/+0.25 degrees and independent endpoint latitude shifts -0.25/0/+0.25 degrees: 81 editorial cases, not physical width, seasonal variation or statistical confidence.
remaining_gates: Diagnose a compatible subsurface axis before asserting continuity across the separate section neighborhoods.
Resolve source recirculation, eastern filaments and termination before whole-current length.
Review historical two-degree latitude width with boundary and month-date precision support; no whole width or seasonal range inferred.
Keep mooring transport variability distinct from seasonal length/width geometry.
figure_source_label: Bourles et al. (1999); Burmeister et al. (2020)

supporting_sources.citation: Burmeister, Luebbecke, Brandt, Claus and Hahn (2020), Fluctuations of the Atlantic North Equatorial Undercurrent and Associated Changes in Oxygen Transports, GRL 47, e2020GL088350, doi:10.1029/2020GL088350.
supporting_sources.locator: Introduction and sections 2–4, pp. 1–4: central 5 N, 23 W observations and 65–270 m definition; data intervals and fixed-box/inferred-transport distinctions.
supporting_sources.role: Central observational context; weak seasonal cycle and episodic intraseasonal events do not establish seasonal geometry.

supporting_sources.citation: Burmeister, Luebbecke, Brandt and Duteil (2019), Interannual Variability of the Atlantic North Equatorial Undercurrent and Its Impact on Oxygen, JGR Oceans 124, 2348–2373, doi:10.1029/2018JC014760.
supporting_sources.locator: Introduction, sections 2.1 and 2.3: 23 W ship sections; model half-width and observational integration boundaries.
supporting_sources.role: Distinguishes chosen transport integration widths and model-domain longitude span from diagnosed current dimensions.

method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 81 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
